title: 23 Effects, One Catalog: My Digest Picks Right | vitalii.no
description:
My daily video digest picks a motion-graphics effect for each news beat, but the step that writes the script and the step that renders the video had no shared vocabulary. The script writer would describe a visual idea in prose, and the renderer had to guess which of its hardcoded effects, if any, matched — which produced mismatched or generic graphics on beats that deserved something specific.

I built a shared skill with a single effects catalog as the source of truth, starting at 12 effects and expanding the same evening to 23 with a reworked shared grammar. Both the script-writing step and the Remotion render now resolve effects through this one catalog, and I added new components to cover beat types the original 12 couldn't express, plus a preview tool so I can check any effect in isolation before it airs.

The script-writing step and the renderer now pick from the exact same 23-effect catalog instead of guessing at each other, and beats that previously got a generic fallback graphic can use a specific one, like a percent ring or a region callout built for that kind of story.
